answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization aims at compressing the main content of a long conversation into a short text... we propose two interaction methods to obtain key information from other roles for enhancing role-oriented summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Role-oriented summaries for each speaker (user summary and agent summary)

answer_2.quote: We adopt six common automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate the summary quality. The metrics include traditional n-gram overlapping metrics, such as ROUGE, BLEU, and distributed representation matching metrics, including BERTScore and MoverScore.

answer_4.quote: We recruit several volunteers and let them evaluate the summaries in the following aspects: (1) Informativeness... (2) Non-redundancy... (3) Fluency... All three aspects are evaluated at the sub-summary level on a three-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each generated summary on Informativeness, Non-redundancy, and Fluency using a three-point scale (0 worst, 1 medium, 2 best).
